description: This PHP file defines a view for configuring campaign email settings within the SuiteCRM system. It is a class extending SugarView that manages display logic and access control for the campaign configuration interface in the administration module.

classes.name: ViewCampaignconfig
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that manages the display and logic for the campaign configuration page within the administrative interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters, including a link to the administration module, for display in the page title.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user has administrative rights to access the campaign configuration page; terminates execution if unauthorized.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and renders the campaign configuration interface, assigning various settings and controls for the user.
